evidence.claim: Two runs with recorded seed 20260824 produced identical ordered rosters uniform=['google-02', 'anthropic-10', 'openai-01', 'anthropic-01', 'google-00', 'anthropic-03'] stratified=['openai-01', 'google-00', 'openai-07', 'anthropic-05', 'anthropic-07', 'google-03']; seed 424242 produced a different uniform roster ['google-04', 'anthropic-07', 'anthropic-10', 'openai-02', 'openai-09', 'anthropic-08'].

Over 1000 stratified draws, seat-stratum counts {'anthropic': 2000.0, 'google': 2000.0, 'openai': 2000.0} equalled requested quotas * n_draws {'anthropic': 2000.0, 'google': 2000.0, 'openai': 2000.0}; Pearson chi-square=0.0 (df=2, critical 5.991 at alpha=0.05). Uniform sampling over the same unbalanced pool is rejected by the same requested-quota check (chi2=173.056).

probes.command: recompute Pearson chi-square from observed vs n_draws*quota

negative_controls.description: Unseeded RNG (seed=None, fresh entropy) must fail the seat-for-seat reproducibility test; the same test is silent on two draws that share recorded seed 20260824.
